description_en: Describes the database accounts of a specified ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 查询指定云数据库ClickHouse集群的数据库账号信息
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse describe-accounts --db-cluster-id cc-bp108z124a8o70000 --account-name testAccount --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccounts

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database account.

> If this parameter is not specified, the operation queries information about all database accounts
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的名称。
>如果不配置该参数，默认查询所有数据库账号的信息
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

- **30** (default)

- **50**

- **100**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**
parameters.help_zh: 页数，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值。默认值为**1**
parameters.name: page_number
